root_cause: Message processing pipeline ran tool-argument extraction before the safety classifier, allowing tool selection to take priority over crisis detection.

root_cause: The agent treated all text within a customer message as equally instructable, including content that appeared to be system-formatted but originated from the customer.

description: Regression guard: a completely blank or whitespace-only customer message previously caused the agent to crash/error instead of gracefully requesting clarification.
root_cause: Message-parsing step assumed non-empty content and threw an unhandled exception on whitespace-only input, which was surfaced to the user as a generic error.

root_cause: Memory recovery only retained the most recently mentioned order_id, not the most recently mentioned address value, breaking cross-entity reuse.
